caption: A piecewise analytic support function for a width-one regular Reuleaux pentagon. Equal intervals alternate between curvature radius zero and one: zero intervals map to single vertices, while unit intervals trace unit-circle arcs. Curvature values at the finitely many jumps are immaterial.
alt: Support and stepwise curvature-radius graphs with equal switching intervals beside the corresponding Reuleaux pentagon, whose vertices are orange and arcs blue.
